{{Quote|You made it! I knew you would.|Jaybo Hood, to Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Mystery Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>}}
'''Jaybo Hood''' was a ten-[[Standard year|year]]-old<ref name="Episode Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/mystery-of-a-thousand-moons-episode-gallery|text="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" Episode Gallery}}</ref> [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who lived on the [[planet]] [[Iego]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. He was a [[Technician|mechanic]] who tinkered with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[battle droid]]s and made them into his own army of personal [[servant]]s.<ref name="Databank" /> When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] found themselves trapped by a [[LaserWeb Defense Station]] on Iego, Hood used his skills to assist them in [[Mission to Iego|escaping]] unharmed.<ref name="Mystery Moons" />

==Biography==
[[File:JayboHammock-MoaTM.png|thumb|left|300px|Jaybo lounges on his hammock strung between two vulture droid legs]]

A [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Databank" /> born c. [[31 BBY]],<ref name="Age" /> Jaybo Hood was one of several individuals who found themselves captive on [[Iego]]. After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]] abandoned Iego, Hood reprogrammed the [[battle droid]]s left behind and used them as servants. He used a [[macro protocol]] to wipe all of their programming simultaneously. When [[High Jedi General|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] arrived on the [[planet]] looking for an [[Reeksa|ingredient]] in the antidote to the [[Blue Shadow Virus]], the latter brashly destroyed eighteen of the defenseless droids.<ref name="Mystery Moons" />

Hood served as their guide around the planet and its creatures and grew fond of the two [[Jedi]] during their stay. Hood told the two Jedi of "[[Drol]]," the "god" of Iego, even mentioning [[Taquito]], a friend of his who was killed upon attempting to leave the planet. Skywalker and Kenobi attempted to leave the planet themselves but were stopped by a [[LaserWeb Defense Station|laser field]] installed by the Separatists to prevent its inhabitants from leaving. Hood lent them several of his commandeered [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] to help them get off-planet and destroy the field. In doing so, Hood indirectly helped free all the marooned inhabitants of Iego, allowing them to leave whenever they wished.<ref name="Mystery Moons" />

==Personality and traits==
Jaybo Hood was a human male<ref name="Databank" /> who stood at 1.4 [[meter]]s, or 4 [[Foot|feet]], 7 inches,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> and had [[Color|red]] [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="Databank" /> Much like Anakin Skywalker in his youth, Hood was smart and resourceful.<ref name="Mystery Rewatch">{{SW|url=news/the-clone-wars-rewatch-mystery-of-a-thousand-moons|text=''The Clone Wars'' Rewatch: That's No "Mystery of a Thousand Moons," It's a Security Field}}</ref> He lived like a king on Iego, waited on by his reprogrammed battle droids. Hood was a [[Technician|mechanic]]<ref name="Join the Battle" /> and a tinkerer,<ref name="Mystery Rewatch" /> who reprogrammed with a macro protocol to obey him.<ref name="Mystery Moons" /> As a tinkerer, he devised a way to not only deactivate battle droids to make them harmless, but to reprogram them to be his servants.<ref name="Mystery Rewatch" /> Like many others on Iego, Hood believed in the curse of Drol, but he was still willing to help Kenobi and Skywalker try to escape the planet.<ref name="Mystery Moons" /> Hood also had a vast knowledge of the flora and fauna of his home planet, which proved crucial in helping Kenobi and Skywalker attain the antidote from the reeksa plants.<ref name="Mystery Rewatch" />

==Skills and abilities==
Hood was a [[technician]] with experience in tinkering, [[Slicer|data slicing]], [[droid]]  programming and repair.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I knew he needed a lot of gear since he was a tinkerer and had rebuilt all of these battle droids. Dave suggested I think of him as a cross between a young Anakin and a young Han Solo.|[[Wayne Lo]] on creating Jaybo Hood|<ref name="Art of The Clone Wars">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>}}
Jaybo Hood first appeared in the episode "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]" from the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. He was voiced by [[David Kaufman]].<ref name="Mystery Moons" /> Concept art and lightning concept art of the character was done by [[Chris Voy]]. Supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] suggested to think of the character as a cross between young Anakin Skywalker and a young [[Han Solo]].<ref name="Art of The Clone Wars" />
